checkpoint_selection: minimum history-only validation ADE within 10 epochs; earliest tie
example_selection: Seed 42; fixed first scene and retrospectively selected largest ADE gain/loss, explicitly labelled
evaluation: single mean rollout, all 64 agents, history only, primary pedestrian scored
data_protocol: exact teacher 56/12/12 chronological scenes; step 2; stride 8; primary IDs 1,17,33,49
units: metres following Week 02 cm-to-m conversion, cross-checked against the 10 m circle
fps_source: 25 fps from Xiao et al. 2018, arXiv:1808.01443; sampled rate 12.5 Hz
study_status: Exploratory follow-up after seeing original test results; not an independent confirmatory test
direction_rule: weight=.25+.75*max(0,cos angle); displacement<.008 m per sample uses weight 1; fixed before training
